title: A previous treatment can carry over
hook: Two stated cases: explore the remaining effect before and after an idealized washout.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the remaining effect before and after an idealized washout affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines ObservedGap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the remaining effect before and after an idealized washout in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
